<documents>
<document id="support-power-of-attorney">
Power of attorney
If you have power of attorney for a Tallowbrook member, our Account Services team can add you to their account as an agent.

## What we need

- A copy of the power of attorney document, signed and in effect
- Your government-issued photo ID
- Your contact details

## How to send it

Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject Power of attorney, or ask the account holder to message support from their session. Support can't review the documents. They go to Account Services.

## How long it takes

Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm what they received, and may ask for more information.

## Until it's approved

We can't share information or take instructions from you until Account Services has approved the document. That includes freezing cards or changing plans.

## If the account holder is in danger

If you think the account holder is being exploited financially, tell us. We treat that as urgent.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-plus-v2">
Plus plan fee schedule
Here is every fee that can apply to a Plus account, effective March 1, 2026. Fees are taken from your main balance when they're charged and show up in your activity feed with the word "Fee".

| Fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | $5.00 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal | $2.50 |
| International ATM withdrawal | $3.00 |
| Foreign transaction fee | 1% |
| Card replacement | $0.00 |
| Expedited card shipping | $25.00 |
| Outgoing domestic wire | $15.00 |
| Outgoing international wire | $35.00 |
| Incoming international wire | $10.00 |
| Cash deposit at a retail store | $3.00 |

## Details

Your first 3 out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month are free. The fee applies from the next one.

No plan has overdraft fees, returned transfer fees or inactivity fees. The monthly fee is charged on your billing date and isn't prorated.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-premium-v2">
Premium plan fee schedule
Here is every fee that can apply to a Premium account, effective March 1, 2026. Fees are taken from your main balance when they're charged and show up in your activity feed with the word "Fee".

| Fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | $15.00 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal | $0.00 |
| International ATM withdrawal | $0.00 |
| Foreign transaction fee | 0% |
| Card replacement | $0.00 |
| Expedited card shipping | $0.00 |
| Outgoing domestic wire | $0.00 |
| Outgoing international wire | $10.00 |
| Incoming international wire | $0.00 |
| Cash deposit at a retail store | $0.00 |

## Details

Premium has no ATM fees from us, and we pay back ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 each month.

No plan has overdraft fees, returned transfer fees or inactivity fees. The monthly fee is charged on your billing date and isn't prorated.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
</documents>
